incident_description:
Between 20:13 UTC and 23:50 UTC on January 15, 2026, customers may have experienced degraded performance while using SQL Warehouses.

The incident is now closed. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Between 06:30 UTC January 14 and 06:45 UTC January 15, 2026, customers may experience failures or delays when launching Serverless compute resources, including Notebooks, Delta Live Tables (DLT), or jobs.

The incident is now closed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.
